mu-cang-chai-mua-lua-chin.title: Mù Cang Chải in Golden Rice Season
mu-cang-chai-mua-lua-chin.blurb: Walk among the La Pán Tẩn rice terraces at harvest time, stay with a H'Mông family and rise early to greet the mist on Khau Phạ Pass.
mu-cang-chai-mua-lua-chin.impact: Local families in the village provide your stay and meals directly.

cho-phien-bac-ha-va-ban-ta-van.title: Bắc Hà Market and Tả Van Village
cho-phien-bac-ha-va-ban-ta-van.blurb: Spend Sunday morning at Bắc Hà Market, head down to Mường Hoa Valley in the afternoon and settle into a wooden home in Tả Van.
cho-phien-bac-ha-va-ban-ta-van.impact: Buy fabric and farm produce directly from market vendors, with no middleman.

fansipan-duong-tram-ton.title: Fansipan via Trạm Tôn Route
fansipan-duong-tram-ton.blurb: Climb Indochina's highest peak over four days, starting at Trạm Tôn and crossing rhododendron forest before two nights camping at 2,800 metres.
fansipan-duong-tram-ton.impact: All porters are Giáy and Dao people who live around Hoàng Liên National Park.

cao-nguyen-da-dong-van.title: Đồng Văn Karst Plateau and Mã Pí Lèng Pass
cao-nguyen-da-dong-van.blurb: Follow the karst plateau through Yên Minh, Lũng Cú and Mã Pí Lèng Pass, with time to linger in each village instead of just passing through.
cao-nguyen-da-dong-van.impact: Stay with a Mông family in Lũng Cẩm rather than at a hotel in the town centre.

ho-ba-be-thuyen-doc-moc.title: Ba Bể Lake by Dugout Canoe
ho-ba-be-thuyen-doc-moc.blurb: Paddle across Vietnam's largest natural freshwater lake, stop by Fairy Pond and spend the night in a Tày stilt house in Pác Ngòi.
highlights: Tày stilt house in Pác Ngòi
ho-ba-be-thuyen-doc-moc.impact: The boat and its skipper are part of Pác Ngòi village's tourism cooperative.

thac-ban-gioc-va-nguom-ngao.title: Bản Giốc Falls and Ngườm Ngao Cave
thac-ban-gioc-va-nguom-ngao.blurb: See the border falls in full flow, explore Ngườm Ngao Cave and visit Phia Thắp, a village known for its incense makers.
highlights: Bản Giốc Falls in the rainy season
thac-ban-gioc-va-nguom-ngao.impact: Visit local incense and handmade-paper workshops in Quốc Dân, and buy directly from the makers.

vinh-lan-ha-va-lang-chai-viet-hai.title: Lan Hạ Bay and Việt Hải Fishing Village
vinh-lan-ha-va-lang-chai-viet-hai.blurb: Kayak among Lan Hạ's limestone karsts, then cycle to Việt Hải, a village tucked inside Cát Bà National Park.
vinh-lan-ha-va-lang-chai-viet-hai.impact: Lunch is cooked in a Việt Hải family home with vegetables and fish caught that day.

trang-an-tam-coc-cuc-phuong.title: Tràng An, Tam Cốc and Cúc Phương Forest
trang-an-tam-coc-cuc-phuong.blurb: Glide by sampan through Tràng An's water caves, cycle past the rice fields of Tam Cốc and spend a night in the old-growth forest of Cúc Phương.
trang-an-tam-coc-cuc-phuong.impact: Your Cúc Phương entry ticket directly supports the primate rescue programme.

bat-trang-va-van-phuc.title: Bát Tràng Pottery and Vạn Phúc Silk
bat-trang-va-van-phuc.blurb: Spend a day in two craft villages near Hà Nội: shape a bowl in Bát Tràng, then watch silk being woven on a loom in Vạn Phúc.
bat-trang-va-van-phuc.impact: Learn directly from craftspeople in family workshops, not at a staged show.

hang-en-phong-nha.title: Hang Én in Phong Nha Kẻ Bàng
hang-en-phong-nha.blurb: Trek 17 kilometres through forest and cross ten streams to reach the world's third-largest cave, where you'll camp for a night on the sandy floor.
highlights: Bru Vân Kiều village of Đoòng
hang-en-phong-nha.impact: Your porter and cooking team are Bru Vân Kiều people from Đoòng village and Tân Trạch commune.

hue-lang-tam-va-song-huong.title: Huế: Imperial Tombs and an Afternoon on the Hương River
hue-lang-tam-va-song-huong.blurb: Visit the Imperial City early, explore the tombs of Minh Mạng and Khải Định at midday, then take a dragon boat along the Hương River at sunset.
highlights: Huế folk music on the Hương River
hue-lang-tam-va-song-huong.impact: Huế folk musicians are paid for each performance, not through guests' tips.

pu-luong-guong-nuoc.title: Pù Luông and Its Water Wheels
pu-luong-guong-nuoc.blurb: Walk between Đôn, Hiêu and Kho Mường villages through tropical forest, sleep in a Thai stilt house and cool off beneath bamboo water wheels.
pu-luong-guong-nuoc.impact: Each village hosts no more than one group a night, giving local life room to carry on as usual.

hoi-an-va-lang-rau-tra-que.title: Hội An and the Trà Quế Herb Village Kitchen
hoi-an-va-lang-rau-tra-que.blurb: Work the soil and pick herbs in Trà Quế in the morning, learn to cook three Quảng dishes at lunch, then stroll Hội An's lantern-lit streets after dark.
hoi-an-va-lang-rau-tra-que.impact: Your cooking class takes place in a local grower's kitchen, and the fee goes straight to the family.

cu-lao-cham-san-ho.title: Cù Lao Chàm and Its Coral Reefs
cu-lao-cham-san-ho.blurb: Take a speedboat to the Cù Lao Chàm Biosphere Reserve, snorkel above coral reefs and share lunch with a local family at Hương Beach.
cu-lao-cham-san-ho.impact: Plastic bags are banned on the island; bring a reusable water bottle for the day.

bau-trang-va-doi-cat-mui-ne.title: Bàu Trắng and the Mũi Né Sand Dunes
bau-trang-va-doi-cat-mui-ne.blurb: Watch the sun rise over the shifting dunes, rest by the lotus lake at Bàu Trắng, wade through Fairy Stream and dine in Mũi Né fishing village.
bau-trang-va-doi-cat-mui-ne.impact: Seafood is bought at the morning fish landing and cooked at a family-run restaurant.

qua-tang-rung-kon-ka-kinh.title: Through Kon Ka Kinh's Forest Canopy
qua-tang-rung-kon-ka-kinh.blurb: Cross old-growth forest, listen to the streams and sleep within one of the Central Highlands' richest ecosystems.
qua-tang-rung-kon-ka-kinh.impact: Travel with park rangers and Bahnar guides who live near the national park.

mot-dem-o-lang-bahnar.title: A Night in a Bahnar Village
mot-dem-o-lang-bahnar.blurb: Share a meal by the fire, listen to the gongs and settle into a gentler rhythm of village life.
mot-dem-o-lang-bahnar.impact: The people of Kon K'Tu village organise the gong performances and homestays, keeping the income in the community.

thac-k50-kon-chu-rang.title: K50 Waterfall in Kon Chư Răng
thac-k50-kon-chu-rang.blurb: For travellers who enjoy a challenge: cross streams, trek deep into the forest and reach the foot of K50, a waterfall over 50 metres high.
thac-k50-kon-chu-rang.impact: Monthly group numbers are limited in agreement with the nature reserve management.

rung-ngap-man-can-gio.title: Cần Giờ Mangrove Forest
rung-ngap-man-can-gio.blurb: Motor along the waterways of a biosphere reserve just outside Sài Gòn, stop at the bat lagoon and have lunch in Thạnh An before heading back.
rung-ngap-man-can-gio.impact: Boats and skippers are hired directly from Thạnh An families, with no transport company in between.

con-dao-rua-va-di-tich.title: Côn Đảo: Turtle Nesting Season
con-dao-rua-va-di-tich.blurb: Stay up with rangers on Bảy Cạnh Island to watch green turtles nest, then explore Côn Đảo Prison and Hàng Dương Cemetery.
highlights: Release of hatchlings to the sea
con-dao-rua-va-di-tich.impact: Your fee goes directly to the national park's sea turtle conservation programme.

nui-ba-den-va-ho-dau-tieng.title: Núi Bà Đen and Dầu Tiếng Lake
nui-ba-den-va-ho-dau-tieng.blurb: Climb the power-line trail to the rooftop of southern Vietnam before sunrise, then camp by Dầu Tiếng Lake and watch the sun go down.
nui-ba-den-va-ho-dau-tieng.impact: Carry all your rubbish back down and collect any litter you find along the trail.

cho-noi-cai-rang-va-cu-lao-tan-loc.title: Cái Răng Floating Market and Tân Lộc Islet
cho-noi-cai-rang-va-cu-lao-tan-loc.blurb: Rise at five for a bowl of hủ tiếu on a boat at the floating market, then head to Tân Lộc Islet to pick fruit and learn to make bánh xèo.
cho-noi-cai-rang-va-cu-lao-tan-loc.impact: Stay at a Tân Lộc orchard home; your room and meals support the family who runs it.

rung-tram-tra-su-mua-nuoc-noi.title: Trà Sư Cajuput Forest in Flood Season
rung-tram-tra-su-mua-nuoc-noi.blurb: Glide through a blanket of green duckweed in a three-plank boat, watch the bird sanctuary from above and enjoy a seasonal floodplain lunch.
highlights: Long bamboo bridge through the forest
rung-tram-tra-su-mua-nuoc-noi.impact: Women from the local hamlet row the boats and are paid per trip, not through guest tips.

dat-mui-ca-mau-va-u-minh-ha.title: Đất Mũi, Cà Mau and U Minh Hạ Forest
dat-mui-ca-mau-va-u-minh-ha.blurb: Ride a motorized wooden boat to Vietnam's southernmost national marker, then visit U Minh Hạ to gather honey and cast a net for freshwater fish.
dat-mui-ca-mau-va-u-minh-ha.impact: A local honey gatherer leads the bee-keeping visit and keeps the honey collected.
